scope: Existing discovery action-label provenance only; not a training or benefit result.

selection.positive_semantics: Successful complete remaining-episode continuation of an originally failed baseline, at a previously selected difficult context; no new difficulty thresholds.
selection.ordinary_successes: Separate potential rehearsal controls, not recovery demonstrations.
selection.successful_original_controls: Separate difficult-context success controls, not failure rescues.

sample_alignment.executed_action_labels: movements t..t+15 inclusive; past action at index0, fifteen usable future commands at indices1..15
sample_alignment.cross_branch_history: Use original prefix, never duplicate branch image as a cold reset.

availability.rgb_reconstruction: Not performed. Requires full executed-action CPU replay from original reset and exact recorded RGB/state checks; hashes alone cannot reconstruct pixels.
availability.latent_policy_rng_history: Not reconstructed or required for executed-action BC labels; cannot reproduce original stochastic predictions from logs alone.

excluded_contexts.reason: Outside fixed discovery pool 0-29; inspected evaluation, not initial training candidates.
Outside fixed discovery pool 0-29; inspected evaluation, not initial training candidates.

limitations: Outcome-conditioned selection does not prove that any action is optimal or that replanning caused recovery.
Windows overlap heavily and branches share prefixes/scenes; counts are not independent demonstrations.
Exact-content duplicate detection uses RGB hashes, observed pusher positions and executed labels, never privileged block pose as model input.
Distinct hashes do not establish meaningful diversity or statistical adequacy.
Difficult-context labels were previously inspected development evidence. No fresh generalization claim follows.
